intent: Remove the forward primer GTGCCAGCAGCCGCGGTAA from the 5' end of these single-end amplicon reads and keep every read that belongs to the amplicon, whichever strand it was sequenced from; reads without the primer should not be kept.
silent_error: cutadapt looks for the adapter only on the strand given. Half of these reads are reverse-complemented (the primer sits at the 3' end as its reverse complement), so with --discard-untrimmed they are counted as 'untrimmed' and silently thrown away; the output looks like a normal, well-trimmed FASTQ with half the reads. The cutadapt summary lists 'Reads discarded as untrimmed: 18 (50.0%)' as a plain statistic, but nothing names read orientation as the cause. --revcomp (documented in the cutadapt guide) checks both orientations and flips reverse reads.
